title: The Ultimate Café Opening Checklist: A Complete Pre-Launch Guide

facts.fact: The TGP International guide states, without citing a source, that a significant percentage of cafés globally fail within their first 12–24 months.
facts.quote: Globally, a significant percentage of cafés fail within their first 12–24 months.

facts.fact: The guide says the most common reason cafés fail is poor pre-opening preparation rather than bad coffee.
facts.quote: The most common reason isn’t bad coffee, it’s poor pre-opening preparation.

facts.fact: The guide was published by TGP International on 19 February 2026.
TGP International says the guide is intended for first-time café founders, investors entering the coffee space, existing operators launching new concepts, and franchisees preparing to open.
The guide lists five café concept formats for founders to choose between: specialty coffee café, grab-and-go espresso bar, lifestyle/community café, roastery & brew bar, and hybrid F&B concept.
The guide says menus must align with brand positioning, speed of service expectations, skill level of staff, and equipment capacity.
The guide lists pre-opening budget items to account for: fit-out overruns, training wages, soft opening costs, and initial marketing spend.
The guide advises café operators to always maintain a contingency buffer within their pre-opening budget.
The guide lists three revenue forecasting inputs to understand before opening: average transaction value, daily customer counts, and monthly fixed vs variable costs.
